mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(occurrence_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, item_table AS material_type, SUM(item_quantity) AS total_amount FROM wkf_supply_request WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND type_enum IN ('CABINET_INBOUND_RECEIPT', 'PHARMACY_STOCK_IN') AND status_enum IN ('AGREE', 'APPROVAL') AND occurrence_time >= #{startDate} AND occurrence_time < #{endDate} GROUP BY month, item_table ORDER BY month, item_table

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(occurrence_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, item_table AS material_type, SUM(item_quantity) AS total_amount FROM wkf_supply_request WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND type_enum = 'CABINET_STOCK_OUT' AND status_enum IN ('AGREE', 'APPROVAL') AND occurrence_time >= #{startDate} AND occurrence_time < #{endDate} GROUP BY month, item_table ORDER BY month, item_table
